title: Engineering note: SSE in server frameworks
text: Server frameworks generally support server-sent events by streaming a text/event-stream response. Starlette and FastAPI use a streaming response; Node.js servers write the headers and keep the response open. Replay is not automatic: the application must persist events with identifiers and read the Last-Event-ID header to send what the client missed.
